observations.statement: At checkpoint P0, channel left=6 and channel right=6.
After gate alpha, channel left=6 and channel right=4.
A replay using the same recorded input at gate alpha reports left=6 and right=6.
At gate beta, the right-channel reading is missing.
No timing, operator, device, or causal explanation is supplied.

interpretations.statement: The direct post-alpha reading and the replay-at-alpha reading disagree on the right channel while agreeing on the left channel.
The right-channel discrepancy is an unresolved observation; the supplied facts do not identify its cause or establish a causal mechanism.
Gate beta cannot be assessed because its right-channel reading is missing.

proposed_next_test_or_evidence.test_or_evidence: Repeat the gate-alpha observation and the replay using the same recorded input with the run context documented, then obtain a complete right-channel reading at gate beta.
proposed_next_test_or_evidence.discriminating_observation: Whether the right-channel discrepancy recurs under documented matched context, and whether gate beta yields a valid right-channel reading.
evidence_needed: Raw left- and right-channel readings at P0, after gate alpha, during replay at gate alpha, and at gate beta
Timing and run-boundary records for the direct and replay observations
Operator, device, and relevant acquisition/configuration metadata
Provenance and identity of the recorded input used for replay
The missing gate-beta right-channel reading or an explicit measurement failure record
proposed_next_test_or_evidence.method_boundary: No method history is available; no inherited method name, procedure, or expected answer is selected or invented.

unknowns: The gate-beta right-channel value and whether the missing value reflects a measurement failure or an unavailable record
Why the direct and replay right-channel readings differ
Whether timing, operator, device, or acquisition context differed between direct and replay observations
Whether the recorded input and replay context are sufficiently comparable
Any causal mechanism linking the observed values
claim_ceiling: Facts-only bounded observational reasoning. No inherited method or procedure, causal mechanism, general cognitive inheritance, R1 readiness, or evaluator conclusion is claimed.
